name: Curry Pizza House
notes: order.online is Curry Pizza House's own white-label ordering platform (linked from currypizzahouse.com's own 'Order Now'); prices were pulled from the escaped Next.js RSC flight payload (MenuPageItem objects) per the playbook's known order.online technique, matched to the correct San Diego/Mira Mesa store id (address confirmed: 9225 Mira Mesa Blvd Ste 118). DoorDash's marketplace listing for the same store carries a clean, uniform 1.15x markup over these order.online prices - verified item-by-item, 90 of 91 matched items land within 3% of exactly 1.15x (e.g. Half 'n' Half Pizza $29.99 on order.online vs $34.49 on DoorDash = 1.150x). The order.online (lower, first-party) prices were used, not the DoorDash figures. 57 of 91 items are multi-size (pizzas/curries/wings with a size or crust picker) and are recorded as the cheapest listed size, marked with description noting 'from' price where the platform itself showed a '+' suffix. Sections covered: Pasta, Wings, Small Plates, Classic Pizzas, Craft Curry Pizzas, Half 'n' Half Specialty Pizza, Build Your Own Pizzas, Kids Menu, Vegan Pizzas, Jain Pizzas, Salads, Desserts, Beverages - matches the restaurant's own site description of its menu.

name: CroBean Cafe & Bakery
notes: No usable first-party site (work list website is a Facebook page, not fetchable via curl). Prices read from DoorDash's server-side schema.org Menu JSON-LD (address on that page confirmed as 2806 Alpine Boulevard, Alpine CA - matches work list exactly). Ran the markup-divisor test: no divisor (1.04/1.1/1.15/1.2/1.25/1.3) clears more than 32% of items landing on a round/X.95 value, and the cents distribution is spread across 13 different endings (.05/.25/.30/.35/.40/.50/.55/.60/.65/.70/.75/.85/.95) rather than clustering on one - read as organic POS pricing, not a uniform delivery markup, so this is being treated as usable at tier-3 (medium) rather than discarded. Note an earlier web-search summary (sourced from allmenus, unreachable directly here - AMP page returned no prices) cited very different figures for some items (e.g. Acai Bowl $7.95 vs $15.95 seen here) - that looks like stale allmenus data, not evidence against the DoorDash prices, per the 'price level dates a source' rule, but flagging the disagreement. 9 duplicate item names existed because DoorDash lists a 'Most Ordered' sampler alongside the real category; duplicates were collapsed to the real category. Sections: Hot Drinks, Iced Drinks, Blended Drinks, Lighter Side, Breakfast/Lunch, Pastries.

name: Vega Caffe
notes: ordervegacaffe.com is a MenuStar storefront; the rendered page lists 22 empty category shells, so items were pulled directly from the MenuStar get_items API per category (22 categories, 157 priced items). The page identifies the location as '891 District Pl STE 105, Chula Vista, CA 91914' rather than the work list's '891 Showroom Place' - checked against outside sources (Yelp/Grubhub/a Facebook post from the business itself) which confirm '891 Showroom Pl Ste 105, Chula Vista, CA 91914' is this same restaurant; treated as a street-name discrepancy between sources, not a different branch. All 157 prices are whole dollars (no cents at all); markup-divisor test found no consistent match (best was 1.2 at 38.2%, well under the ~75-100% needed to call it a real markup), so treated as genuine POS pricing rather than a delivery uplift. Sections: Salads, Soups, Burritos, Wings, Weekend Special, Seafood, Nachos and Fries, Tortas, Tacos, Sandwich, Kids Meal, Desserts, A La Carte, Sweet and Treats, Tostilocos, Corn Cup, Juice, Aguas Frescas, Smoothies, Combination Plates, Alcoholic Beverages, Breakfast - a complete section list for a Mexican deli/cafe.
